gold_spans: no later than one month after the end of the quarter to which it relates
question: When is the quarterly CBAM report due during the transitional period?
reference_answer:
The CBAM report is due no later than one month after the end of the quarter
it relates to [syn_impl_reg_reporting#0001]. A report counts as submitted once the registry has
assigned it a unique report identification number [syn_impl_reg_reporting#0001].

gold_spans: It does not apply to goods whose total intrinsic value, per consignment, does not exceed EUR 150
question: What is the de minimis threshold, and is it per consignment or per year?
reference_answer:
The mechanism does not apply to goods whose total intrinsic value per
consignment does not exceed EUR 150 [syn_reg_main#0001]. The threshold is expressed
per consignment, not per year [syn_reg_main#0001].

gold_spans: shall take a decision within 120 calendar days of receipt of a complete application
question: How long does the competent authority have to decide on an authorisation application?
reference_answer:
The competent authority must decide within 90 calendar days of receiving a
complete application [syn_reg_main#0006]. The period is suspended while the authority
waits for additional information it has requested [syn_reg_main#0006].

gold_spans: corresponds to at least 80 per cent of the embedded emissions in all goods it has imported since the beginning of the calendar year
question: What share of embedded emissions must be covered by certificates at the end of each quarter?
reference_answer:
At the end of each quarter the declarant's registry account must hold
certificates covering at least 80 per cent of the embedded emissions in all
goods imported since the start of that calendar year [syn_reg_main#0009].

gold_spans: the average of the closing prices of emission allowances on the common auction platform for each calendar week
question: How is the CBAM certificate price set?
reference_answer:
The price is the average of the closing prices of emission allowances on the
common auction platform for each calendar week [syn_faq#0000]. Where a week has
no auctions, the price of the last week with auctions is used [syn_faq#0000].

gold_spans: carbon dioxide for all goods, nitrous oxide for fertilisers, and perfluorocarbons for aluminium
question: Which gases are covered for fertilisers?
reference_answer:
Carbon dioxide is covered for all goods, and nitrous oxide is additionally
covered for fertilisers [syn_reg_main#0012].

gold_spans: The number of certificates subject to repurchase shall be limited to one third of the total number of CBAM certificates purchased by the authorised CBAM declarant during the previous calendar year
question: Can we get money back for certificates we did not need?
reference_answer:
Yes. A Member State repurchases any excess certificates on request, with no
limit on the quantity, at the market price prevailing on the date of the
request [syn_reg_main#0010]. Requests can be made at any point in the year.

gold_spans: A penalty of between EUR 10 and EUR 50 per tonne of unreported embedded emissions shall be imposed
question: What penalty applies for not submitting a report?
reference_answer:
The penalty is between EUR 10 and EUR 50 per tonne of unreported embedded
emissions. It is higher where more than two incomplete or incorrect reports
have been submitted in a row, or where the failure lasts more than six
months.

gold_spans: may modify a submitted CBAM report until two months after the end of the relevant reporting quarter
may modify the CBAM reports for the first two reporting periods until the submission deadline of the third CBAM report
question: How long do we have to correct a submitted report?
reference_answer:
A submitted report can be modified until two months after the end of the
relevant quarter [syn_impl_reg_reporting#0002]. For the first two reporting periods only, the
window runs to the submission deadline of the third report [syn_impl_reg_reporting#0002].

gold_spans: For iron and steel, aluminium and hydrogen, only direct emissions are covered during the transitional period
question: Do we report indirect emissions for iron and steel during the transitional period?
reference_answer:
No. For iron and steel, aluminium and hydrogen only direct emissions are
covered during the transitional period; indirect emissions are covered for
cement, fertilisers and electricity [syn_reg_main#0012].

gold_spans: Member States shall sell CBAM certificates to authorised CBAM declarants through a common central platform
question: What is the VAT treatment of CBAM certificates?
reference_answer:
The retrieved context does not address the VAT treatment of CBAM
certificates. It covers how certificates are sold, priced, surrendered,
repurchased and cancelled [syn_reg_main#0008], but says nothing about VAT. I cannot
answer this from the context provided.

gold_spans: Where the importer is not established in a Member State, the indirect customs representative shall apply
question: Who applies for authorised declarant status if the importer is established outside the EU?
reference_answer:
The indirect customs representative applies where the importer is not
established in a Member State [syn_reg_main#0003].

gold_spans: Give the importer the installation name and address, the geographical coordinates of the main emission source, and the United Nations code for trade and transport locations for the site
question: How does an operator identify its installation to importers?
reference_answer:
Operators should register on the CBAM transitional registry and obtain an
operator identification number, which importers then quote in their
quarterly reports [syn_guidance_operators#9999]. Registration opened in 2023 and is free.

gold_spans: until 31 December 2025 estimated values may be used for up to 20 per cent of the total embedded emissions of complex goods
question: When can estimated values still be used after 2024?
reference_answer:
From 1 January 2025 only the standard method may be used, except that until
31 December 2025 estimated values may cover up to 20 per cent of the total
embedded emissions of complex goods, where the declarant records why actual
data could not be obtained [syn_impl_reg_reporting#0003].

gold_spans: where the holder has failed to comply with the obligation to surrender CBAM certificates, or has failed to submit a CBAM declaration by the deadline in Article 6 for two consecutive years
question: On what grounds can authorised declarant status be revoked?
reference_answer:
Status is revoked where the holder no longer meets the authorisation
criteria [syn_reg_main#0007].
